prompts.name: city-plate
prompts.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: independently moving background SCENERY PLATE for a 750x1334 portrait mobile stacking game.
Input image: exact approved art/style/composition reference.
Primary request: Recreate ONLY the city environment from the reference, with the entire CENTRAL playable tower, its foundation pedestal, hanging floor, crane, hook, cable, both flying residents, sparkles and ALL UI/text/hearts/buttons/counters completely REMOVED. The central corridor must be empty open transparent sky all the way down to an empty paved plaza at bottom. Preserve the beautiful ivory/blue-glass towers flanking left and right, distant hazy buildings, terrace/bridge, trees, lamps, coral railings and sunlit paved plaza.
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: remove the BLUE SKY too: sky and sky gaps above/between buildings are genuine alpha transparency, not black or a solid background. A few soft white clouds may remain as transparent-edged objects. Buildings, trees, pavement at the bottom remain opaque. Central plaza is flat and EMPTY, no tower pedestal or foundation. Architecture strongest toward side edges, quieter in middle. Full-bleed portrait 9:16 composition, bottom pavement reaches lower edge, no empty border at bottom. Art direction: EXACTLY match the approved reference image's sunlit miniature metropolis: warm ivory ceramic/stone, sea-blue glass, coral-orange accents, soft sage greenery, tiny brass details, soft dimensional 3D model rendering, warm upper-left sunshine, clean broad readable shapes. This is production game art for an existing portrait stacking game. No pixel art, no black outlines, no dirty/gritty textures, no words, no logo, no watermark.

prompts.name: modules
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: THREE standalone apartment building modules on one transparent sprite sheet, uniform ONE ROW / THREE COLUMNS, equally sized cells.
Input image: approved STYLE and architectural-detail reference.
Primary request: Create 3 separate stackable modules that can repeat vertically in game. LEFT: the ivory/blue-glass apartment floor from the reference, coral-orange right side structural strip, brass balcony railing, warm tiny pendant light and small plant inside, large continuous glass panes. MIDDLE: same EXACT architecture, size and shape, but sage/sea-blue right accent instead of coral, tiny interior arrangement variation. RIGHT: matching single-story ground-floor entrance lobby, ivory facade, warmly lit glass double door, brass details, coral right strip.
All three are ONE story only, same width/height and camera. Each module is isolated in its cell with alpha transparency. Camera is nearly front elevation with a small right side face (about 15% width), orthographic, vertical walls absolutely straight and parallel. The TOP and BOTTOM horizontal cornices are parallel; DO NOT show the roof or underside, do not taper. Modules must stack edge-to-edge with no gaps. Soft rounded cornice corners and subtle built-in shadows; modern collectible architectural model.
Each visible module width:height approximately 1.31:1, moderately wide, not tall/narrow. No roof, no ground base, no shadows on a floor, no cable or hook, no people, no tower, no other objects. Art direction: EXACTLY match the approved reference image's sunlit miniature metropolis: warm ivory ceramic/stone, sea-blue glass, coral-orange accents, soft sage greenery, tiny brass details, soft dimensional 3D model rendering, warm upper-left sunshine, clean broad readable shapes.
